# The process-boundary harness starts in a real Git repository so `card init`
# exercises the repository-local exclude path used by normal installations.

exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix task-
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/init.txt
exists .cardamom/config.yaml
exists .cardamom/board.sqlite3
! exists .cardamom/example.json
cmp .cardamom/config.yaml $WORK/golden/config.yaml
cmp .git/info/exclude $WORK/golden/git-exclude.txt
! exec git check-ignore .cardamom/config.yaml
! stdout .

exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: task-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'
exec card create --priority 1 --summary 'Restore primary power.' 'Repair warp core'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create.txt

exec card --json show task-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/show-open.json

exec card --actor geordi claim task-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/claim.txt

exec card close task-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/close.txt
exec card --json show task-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/show-closed.json

-- golden/show-open.json --

-- golden/init.txt --
initialized .cardamom
This checkout now excludes Cardamom's local database and attachment blob files. .cardamom/config.yaml remains suitable to commit.
-- golden/config.yaml --

# exclude patterns (uncomment them if you want to use them):
# *.[oa]
# *~
.cardamom/board.sqlite3*
.cardamom/blobs/
-- golden/create.txt --
